test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who has been signed on as a brand ambassador of lubricant manufacturer Gulf Oil India in October 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Smriti Mandhana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Smriti Mandhana, an Indian cricketer**, has agreed to serve as a **brand ambassador for Gulf Oil India,** a producer of **lubricants**.
 
• As an **ambassador** for the firm, the **India women's vice-captain **joins current men's cricket star** Hardik Pandya **and **former captain Mahendra Singh Dhoni.**
 
• In addition to recognising the accomplishments of **Indian women cricketers**, **Gulf Oil** claimed that it hopes to "**celebrate women power**" and "inspire female audiences in the country" with the **cooperation**.
 
• Through this partnership,** Gulf Oil** claims to be the first lubricant company to name a female cricket player as an **ambassador** to represent the group and its culture. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• ​**Gulf Oil** is aware that the dynamics of the automobile industry have changed, with more women now having a significant part in the choice to buy a vehicle and in its ongoing maintenance.
 
• The organisation claims to have recognised the shifting consumer demographics with the inclusion of **Smriti Mandhana** to its** roster of ambassadors** and is dedicated to appeal to and serve the new evolving customer environment in the segment.
